event.title: Trump Highlights White House Ballroom Amid GOP Midterm Losses
event.canonical_title: Trump Highlights White House Ballroom Amid GOP Midterm Losses
event.summary: Following significant losses for the Republican Party in the midterm elections, President Trump hosted an event in the unfinished White House ballroom. During his first public appearance after the elections, he focused on the ballroom's construction and largely avoided discussing the GOP's electoral performance.

timeline.title: Trump Reflects on Deportation Policy After Midterm Losses
timeline.summary: In a recent interview, Trump acknowledged that his administration's strict deportation policy may have contributed to the Republican Party's losses in the midterm elections. He expressed a willingness to collaborate with Democrats in the new Congress to reach an immigration agreement.
key_facts: Trump stated his deportation policy might have been too tough.
He believes this policy may have influenced midterm election outcomes.
Trump is open to working with Democrats on immigration reform.
